decisions: Keep the game and bridge protocol at version 1; the 28-byte regional LocalPresenceStateV1 replaces the dormant 16-byte placeholder payload.
WorldLocation wire coordinates are map-local. PlayerGetDestCoords includes MAP_OFFSET, so export subtracts it and rendering adds it exactly once after signed bounds checks.
Remove the player ObjectEvent mapGroup/mapNum export guard because those fields can remain stale across seamless connections.
Decode inbound lifecycle frames in CoopNetBridge_Poll, retain a latest pending target, and mutate ObjectEvents at the start of normal CB1_Overworld before input processing.
Reserve local ObjectEvent ID 0xFC, never evict a map object, and re-resolve ObjectEvent/sprite ownership every field frame.
Interpolate sprite base x/y over exactly six frames; x2/y2 remain zero so reflections, shadows, depth, and field effects stay coherent.
Remote players never participate in normal ObjectEvent collision or first-match position lookup, while overlapping real objects remain discoverable.
Remote A interaction has an explicit consumed-without-lock result and remains consumed even when its bounded outbound queue is full.
Warp commit increments the local nonzero warp sequence and immediately clears reducer, pending interpolation, and renderer state.
risks: SpawnSpecialObjectEventParameterized currently leaves part of its temporary template uninitialized and ignores palette allocation failure.
Cached sprite slots can be reused after ObjectEvent resets and must never be trusted for teardown.
Ordinary TRUE from the field input hook locks controls when no script was started.
Applying target mutation at the top of CB2 leaves one input frame observing stale logical coordinates.
